question: Are the seven A.alcinous source-leaf blocks in which both larvae were lost systematically different in PRETREATMENT leaf surface area, larval initial mass, or use of composite multi-ID leaf material, after conditioning on original source strain?
unit: 30 recorded A.alcinous l.id source-block pairs, with separately recorded AAI/control original initial leaf areas and initial larval weights, original strain shared within pair
frozen_covariates: mean pretreatment leaf-half area per source pair
mean log initial caterpillar body mass per source pair
binary original composite l.id containing comma (multiple source components represented by one l.id)
outcome: Both AAI and control larva coded loss=1 in original source, n=7 of 30. Do not call this AAI lethality or new competition mechanism.
statistics: Within each original strain, permute observed both-loss indicator across the original source leaf pairs keeping number jointly lost in each strain fixed. For continuous covariates compare unconditional original-group mean difference and within-strain fixed-label randomization p two-sided by absolute difference, 9999 seeded Monte Carlo draws. For composite ID binary, same stratum-restricted permutation and difference in proportions. Report all three, no selection of favorable sign.
multiple_test_policy: Three hypotheses exploratory. Report unadjusted p and Holm-adjusted p; never claim confirmatory significance because predictors were selected after prior coloss discovery.
source_integrity: Exact MD5 verification of both original data files
join by h.id and require matching l.id + treatment, flag one known l.or.r discrepancy without silently repairing
original 30 leaf pairs and original 4 A.alcinous strain groups, each with both treatment halves
retain all original larvae including loss=1, no conditioning on observed 24h growth
do not compare final measured leaf area, which is post-exposure and outcome-dependent
stop: If none of the three PRETREATMENT features predicts both-loss after restricting original source strain, no further endogenous posthoc variable scans. If one does, still observational association cannot disentangle plant quality, initial mass, sampling/batch handling, or microenvironment.
